notes: The first open of the day is quicker. While you use the app, it gets tomorrow's Today ready on your phone, so the next morning Today and the Check In button show straight away and are checked against aTAS behind. Your punch is still checked against aTAS before it is saved.

In the morning, the app renews its sign-in before asking for your data, instead of being refused first and asking again, and it reads your attendance figures together with your punches. Fresh data arrives sooner.
